title: Hotel Booking Clone
scenario: A hotel email says your reservation will be cancelled unless you re-enter your card.

answers.A: Click/pay immediately to avoid losing the booking or offer.
answers.B: Forward it to a fellow traveller and ask what they think.
answers.C: Check inside the official app, booking, provider, or government site.
answers.D: Ignore/report the message and use a known contact route.

explanation: Hotel Booking Clone: the trap is to collect private data, images, or documents under pressure. The safer move is to verify through an official or approved channel, not to click or follow the risky request.
proTip: Booking changes should be confirmed in the hotel or platform account.
